issues.summary: The expired-session authorization case does not directly assert AUTH_REQUIRED.
issues.evidence: The test creates a real AuthSession with a 1-second TTL, waits 1.1 seconds, and calls the debug endpoint through the real guard, but the direct assertion is expect(expired.status).toBe(401). The response body is not parsed and error.code is not checked. Since other failures could retain a 401 response while changing the error code, this does not directly bind the expired caller to AUTH_REQUIRED as required by the prior review.
